Measured with a scripted at-will player: 38 of 48 half-metre and metre moves of one wait stay clean on route G (0 of 48 from the old posts), 48 of 48 on route A, 45 of 48 on route B (briefs/027/waymark/quiet-robust-0.18.txt). The board-and-go twins keep the old posts: with these they win at the same time and Trail, but the crew no longer breaks before the car leaves (Standing 2 for 3).
